AWS for ML Engineers: Serverless Infrastructure

Practical AWS for machine learning workloads. Learn Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, and SageMaker from the infrastructure-as-code perspective. Covers Terraform patterns for ML pipelines, cost optimization for bursty workloads, and IAM least-privilege design. No prior AWS experience required.
